description: The UI is served by the in-process core over loopback, so IPC is granted to that origin. Native notification permission, settings and delivery (the plugin supplies notifications outside macOS), window dragging (the top row is the title bar on macOS) and the minimize, maximize and close that a layout's own title bar draws (mods' `window.*` commands) the native folder picker (Add project), opening a link in the OS browser, claiming the `perch://` link that launched the app, opening local explorer entries in their default apps, revealing them in Finder and driving the built-in browser's webviews only. It is granted to the main webview, not the window: the browser tabs are child webviews of the same window and must get no IPC.
